063/**
064 *  Manages searching the Wiki.
065 *
066 *  @since 2.2.21.
067 */
068public class DefaultSearchManager extends BasePageFilter implements SearchManager {
069
070    private static final Logger LOG = LogManager.getLogger( DefaultSearchManager.class );
071
072    private SearchProvider m_searchProvider;
073
074    /**
075     *  Creates a new SearchManager.
076     *
077     *  @param engine The Engine that owns this SearchManager.
078     *  @param properties The list of Properties.
079     *  @throws FilterException If it cannot be instantiated.
080     */
081    public DefaultSearchManager( final Engine engine, final Properties properties ) throws FilterException {
082        initialize( engine, properties );
083        WikiEventManager.addWikiEventListener( m_engine.getManager( PageManager.class ), this );
084
085        // TODO: Replace with custom annotations. See JSPWIKI-566
086        WikiAjaxDispatcherServlet.registerServlet( JSON_SEARCH, new JSONSearch() );
087        WikiAjaxDispatcherServlet.registerServlet( PLUGIN_SEARCH, new PluginSearch() );
088    }
089
090    /**
091     *  Provides a JSON AJAX API to the JSPWiki Plugin discovery mechanism,
092     *  primarily used for [{}] based auto complete
093     */
094    public class PluginSearch implements WikiAjaxServlet {
095
096        public static final String AJAX_ACTION_PLUGINS = "plugins";
097        public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS = 20;
098        public int maxResults = DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS;
099
100        /** {@inheritDoc} */
101        @Override
102        public String getServletMapping() {
103            return PLUGIN_SEARCH;
104        }
105        public static class SimpleSnipData {
106            public String displayName;
107            public String snip;
108        }
109
110        /** {@inheritDoc} */
111        @Override
112        public void service( final HttpServletRequest req,
113                             final HttpServletResponse resp,
114                             final String actionName,
115                             final List< String > params ) throws IOException {
116            String result = "[]";
117            resp.setContentType("application/json");
118            if( actionName != null && StringUtils.isNotBlank( actionName ) ) {
119                if( actionName.equals( AJAX_ACTION_PLUGINS ) ) {
120                    LOG.debug( "Calling getPlugins() START" );
121                    PluginManager mgr = m_engine.getManager(PluginManager.class);
122                    final List< Plugin > plugins = mgr.getDiscoveredPlugins();
123                    List< SimpleSnipData > callResults = new ArrayList<>();
124                   
125                    Locale locale = req.getLocale();
126                    if (locale == null) {
127                        locale = Locale.getDefault();
128                    }
129                    for (Plugin p : plugins) {
130                        try {
131                            SimpleSnipData data = new SimpleSnipData();
132                            data.snip = p.getSnipExample();
133                            data.displayName = p.getDisplayName(locale);
134                            callResults.add(data);
135                        } catch (Throwable t) {
136                            LOG.warn("failed to get plugin informatiom from " + p.getClass().getCanonicalName(), t);
137                        }
138                    }
139                    LOG.debug("Calling getSuggestions() DONE. " + callResults.size() );
140                    result = AjaxUtil.toJson( callResults );
141                } 
142            }
143            LOG.debug( "result=" + result );
144            resp.getWriter().write( result );
145        }
146    }
147    
148    /**
149     *  Provides a JSON AJAX API to the JSPWiki Search Engine.
150     */
151    public class JSONSearch implements WikiAjaxServlet {
152
153        public static final String AJAX_ACTION_SUGGESTIONS = "suggestions";
154        public static final String AJAX_ACTION_PAGES = "pages";
155        public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS = 20;
156        public int maxResults = DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS;
157
158        /** {@inheritDoc} */
159        @Override
160        public String getServletMapping() {
161            return JSON_SEARCH;
162        }
163
164        /** {@inheritDoc} */
165        @Override
166        public void service( final HttpServletRequest req,
167                             final HttpServletResponse resp,
168                             final String actionName,
169                             final List< String > params ) throws IOException {
170            String result = "[]";
171            resp.setContentType("application/json");
172            if( StringUtils.isNotBlank( actionName ) ) {
173                if( params.isEmpty() ) {
174                    return;
175                }
176                final String itemId = params.get( 0 );
177                LOG.debug( "itemId=" + itemId );
178                if( params.size() > 1 ) {
179                    final String maxResultsParam = params.get( 1 );
180                    LOG.debug( "maxResultsParam=" + maxResultsParam );
181                    if( StringUtils.isNotBlank( maxResultsParam ) && StringUtils.isNumeric( maxResultsParam ) ) {
182                        maxResults = Integer.parseInt( maxResultsParam );
183                    }
184                }
185
186                if( actionName.equals( AJAX_ACTION_SUGGESTIONS ) ) {
187                    LOG.debug( "Calling getSuggestions() START" );
188                    final List< String > callResults = getSuggestions( itemId, maxResults );
189                    LOG.debug( "Calling getSuggestions() DONE. " + callResults.size() );
190                    result = AjaxUtil.toJson( callResults );
191                } else if( actionName.equals( AJAX_ACTION_PAGES ) ) {
192                    LOG.debug("Calling findPages() START");
193                    final Context wikiContext = Wiki.context().create( m_engine, req, ContextEnum.PAGE_VIEW.getRequestContext() );
194                    final List< Map< String, Object > > callResults = findPages( itemId, maxResults, wikiContext );
195                    LOG.debug( "Calling findPages() DONE. " + callResults.size() );
196                    result = AjaxUtil.toJson( callResults );
197                }
198            }
199            LOG.debug( "result=" + result );
200            resp.getWriter().write( result );
201        }
202
203        /**
204         *  Provides a list of suggestions to use for a page name. Currently, the algorithm just looks into the value parameter,
205         *  and returns all page names from that.
206         *
207         *  @param wikiName the page name
208         *  @param maxLength maximum number of suggestions
209         *  @return the suggestions
210         */
211        public List< String > getSuggestions( String wikiName, final int maxLength ) {
212            final StopWatch sw = new StopWatch();
213            sw.start();
214            final List< String > list = new ArrayList<>( maxLength );
215            if( !wikiName.isEmpty() ) {
216                // split pagename and attachment filename
217                String filename = "";
218                final int pos = wikiName.indexOf("/");
219                if( pos >= 0 ) {
220                    filename = wikiName.substring( pos ).toLowerCase();
221                    wikiName = wikiName.substring( 0, pos );
222                }
223
224                final String cleanWikiName = MarkupParser.cleanLink(wikiName).toLowerCase() + filename;
225                final String oldStyleName = MarkupParser.wikifyLink(wikiName).toLowerCase() + filename;
226                final Set< String > allPages = m_engine.getManager( ReferenceManager.class ).findCreated();
227               
228                int counter = 0;
229                for( final Iterator< String > i = allPages.iterator(); i.hasNext() && counter < maxLength; ) {
230                    final String p = i.next();
231                    final String pp = p.toLowerCase();
232                    if( pp.startsWith( cleanWikiName) || pp.startsWith( oldStyleName ) ) {
233                        list.add( p );
234                        counter++;
235                    }
236                }
237            }
238
239            sw.stop();
240            LOG.debug( "Suggestion request for {} done in {}", wikiName, sw );
241            return list;
242        }
243
244        /**
245         *  Performs a full search of pages.
246         *
247         *  @param searchString The query string
248         *  @param maxLength How many hits to return
249         *  @return the pages found
250         */
251        public List< Map< String, Object > > findPages( final String searchString, final int maxLength, final Context wikiContext ) {
252            final StopWatch sw = new StopWatch();
253            sw.start();
254
255            final List< Map< String, Object > > list = new ArrayList<>( maxLength );
256            if( !searchString.isEmpty() ) {
257                try {
258                    final Collection< SearchResult > c;
259                    if( m_searchProvider instanceof LuceneSearchProvider ) {
260                        c = ( ( LuceneSearchProvider )m_searchProvider ).findPages( searchString, 0, wikiContext );
261                    } else {
262                        c = m_searchProvider.findPages( searchString, wikiContext );
263                    }
264
265                    int count = 0;
266                    for( final Iterator< SearchResult > i = c.iterator(); i.hasNext() && count < maxLength; count++ ) {
267                        final SearchResult sr = i.next();
268                        final HashMap< String, Object > hm = new HashMap<>();
269                        hm.put( "page", sr.getPage().getName() );
270                        hm.put( "score", sr.getScore() );
271                        list.add( hm );
272                    }
273                } catch( final Exception e ) {
274                    LOG.info( "AJAX search failed; ", e );
275                }
276            }
277
278            sw.stop();
279            LOG.debug( "AJAX search complete in {}", sw );
280            return list;
281        }
282    }
283
284
285    /** {@inheritDoc} */
286    @Override
287    public void initialize( final Engine engine, final Properties properties ) throws FilterException {
288        m_engine = engine;
289        loadSearchProvider(properties);
290
291        try {
292            m_searchProvider.initialize( engine, properties );
293        } catch( final NoRequiredPropertyException | IOException e ) {
294            LOG.error( e.getMessage(), e );
295        }
296    }
297
298    private void loadSearchProvider( final Properties properties ) {
299        // See if we're using Lucene, and if so, ensure that its index directory is up-to-date.
300        final String providerClassName = TextUtil.getStringProperty( properties, PROP_SEARCHPROVIDER, DEFAULT_SEARCHPROVIDER );
301
302        try {
303            m_searchProvider = ClassUtil.buildInstance( "org.apache.wiki.search", providerClassName );
304        } catch( final ReflectiveOperationException e ) {
305            LOG.warn( "Failed loading SearchProvider, will use BasicSearchProvider.", e );
306        }
307
308        if( null == m_searchProvider ) {
309            m_searchProvider = new BasicSearchProvider();
310        }
311        LOG.debug( "Loaded search provider {}", m_searchProvider );
312    }
313
314    /** {@inheritDoc} */
315    @Override
316    public SearchProvider getSearchEngine()
317    {
318        return m_searchProvider;
319    }
320
321    /** {@inheritDoc} */
322    @Override
323    public void actionPerformed( final WikiEvent event ) {
324        if( event instanceof WikiPageEvent ) {
325            final String pageName = ( ( WikiPageEvent ) event ).getPageName();
326            if( event.getType() == WikiPageEvent.PAGE_DELETE_REQUEST ) {
327                final Page p = m_engine.getManager( PageManager.class ).getPage( pageName );
328                if( p != null ) {
329                    pageRemoved( p );
330                }
331            }
332            if( event.getType() == WikiPageEvent.PAGE_REINDEX ) {
333                final Page p = m_engine.getManager( PageManager.class ).getPage( pageName );
334                if( p != null ) {
335                    reindexPage( p );
336                }
337            }
338        }
339    }
